topic: Impact of Human Activities in an Ecosystem
key_concepts: Pollutants enter the biosphere through land, air, or water
Fertilizer, pesticide, and herbicide runoff can contaminate bodies of water
Fertilizer buildup can cause algal blooms that kill aquatic ecosystems
Improper waste disposal pollutes soil and water and attracts disease-carrying organisms
Inorganic fertilizers and pesticides can alter soil nutrients and reduce organic matter
Kaingin farming, illegal logging, and cutting immature trees cause soil erosion and flash
Smog is a sign of air pollution caused by vehicle emissions and smoke-belching
Carbon monoxide from vehicle congestion can cause respiratory ailments
Greenhouse gases such as carbon dioxide, methane, and nitrous oxide hasten global warming
Monoculture depletes soil nutrients and encourages resistant pests and diseases
Chemical fertilizers can increase soil acidity and destroy soil structure
